        ; fun twice(x: u8 = C) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        twice:
            ; fixed C ABI marker
            LD A, C
            ADD A, C
            RET
        
        ; fun offset(x: u8 = A) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        offset:
            LD C, 3
            ADD A, C
            RET
        
        ; fun multi(x: u8 = A) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        multi:
            ; genCall: twice dst=8
            PUSH AF
            LD C, A
            CALL twice
            LD B, A
            POP AF
            ; genCall: offset dst=9
            PUSH BC
            CALL offset
            POP BC
            ADD A, B
            RET

    pfcco_multicall_audit_test.go:276: condtrue clsgeneral 49585T27B
        ; generated by MIR2 Z80 codegen
        
        ; fun twice(x: u8 = C) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        twice:
            ; fixed C ABI marker
            LD A, C
            ADD A, C
            RET
        
        ; fun offset(x: u8 = D) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        offset:
            LD C, 3
            LD A, C
            ADD A, D
            RET
        
        ; fun multi(x: u8 = C) -> u8 = A ; clobbers: A, B, BC, C, D, DE, E, F, H, HL, IX, IXH, IXL, IY, IYH, IYL, L
        multi:
            ; genCall: twice dst=8
            PUSH BC
            CALL twice
            POP BC
            LD E, A    ; preserve live accumulator before CMP
            LD A, C
            AND A
            LD A, E
            ; restore live-out r8 from scratch
            RET Z
        .multi_yes:
            ; genCall: offset dst=11
            PUSH AF
            LD D, C
            CALL offset
            LD B, A
            POP AF
            ADD A, B
            RET
